description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的**应用管理**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the application group. You can find this ID on the **Application Management** page in the console.

description.zh: 任务ID列表，多个任务ID以半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The IDs of the jobs to disable.

description.zh: 任务所属命名空间ID，在控制台**命名空间**页面中获取。
description.en: The ID of the namespace that contains the jobs. You can find this ID on the **Namespaces** page in the console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写。
description.en: This parameter is used only by specific third-party services.
The ID of the region where the jobs are located.

descriptions.zh:
在调用该接口前，需要在POM文件添加以下依赖：

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.4</version>
</dependency>
```
descriptions.en:
To call this API, add the following dependency to your POM File:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.aliyun</groupId>
    <artifactId>aliyun-java-sdk-schedulerx2</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.4</version>
</dependency>
```

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 batch-disable-jobs --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id-list 99341 --region cn-hangzhou
